notes.title: Tiny replay function
notes.notes: If you have reached the last level, it is now possible to replay Lungs 1-5 by pressing 1-5 while on the first menu page.

notes.title: Sylvio: Black Waters is out now!
notes.notes:
The lake is calling you... come embrace the black waters of the unknown.

[previewyoutube=7gVN9O6pz7M;full][/previewyoutube]

After landing on a strange planet, Juliette comes across a strange glowing statue wearing... a watch? 

From the watch comes the voice of Lee, the disembodied voice of the planet's only other... living inhabitant. With the guidance of your mysterious contact, you'll attempt unravel the past before it's too late for your future.

Will Juliette be able to make sense of the mind-bending realities of this new planet, and uncover the story of what happened here?

To find out, you must enter the world of [i][b]Sylvio: Black Waters[/b][/i]

notes.title: Sylvio: Black Waters Launches July 25th
notes.notes:
[h3]Time To Smell The Devil[/h3]

[i][b]Sylvio: Black Waters[/b][/i] is a first-person exploration horror game from the creator of [b][i]Sylvio [/i][/b]and [i][b]Sylvio 2[/b][/i]. A glorious return to form with fresh mechanics, this physics-defying and puzzle-filled experience will thrill followers of the series while being inviting enough for new fans.
